prioritized_fixes.title: Motion language consistency
prioritized_fixes.fix: Consolidate to [0.22,1,0.36,1] plus one utility curve: replace (.85,0,.15,1), (.25,1,.5,1) and (.4,0,.6,1) usages and override Tailwind's default transition-timing-function in the config.
prioritized_fixes.notes: The brand curve cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) dominates (9 occurrences in compiled CSS) but 5 other curves coexist: (.85,0,.15,1), (.4,0,.2,1), (.25,1,.5,1), (0,0,.2,1), (.4,0,.6,1) — 6 unique curves vs the ≤2 standard, even granting some are Tailwind defaults on micro-transitions.

prioritized_fixes.title: Visual identity coherence

No owned email channel exists yet.

prioritized_fixes.title: Mobile typography stress test
prioritized_fixes.fix: Verify the letter-split H1 at 375px (white-space:nowrap per word or wrap letters in per-word spans); add explicit mobile line breaks if any word group wraps mid-word.
prioritized_fixes.notes:
Current H1 words are short ('Design ops & delivery systems — built to scale.' — longest token 'delivery', low overflow risk at 375px) and the H1 is rendered twice suggesting desktop/mobile variants. But the letter-split animation (every character in its own span) can wrap mid-word at any character, and no explicit
mobile stack or rendered-viewport verification exists in evidence.
